name_jp: ミダックホールディングス
summary_en: ROE target to remain above 7–9% estimated WACC; FY3/26 ROE 17.3%, PBR 2.95x (3.02x as of 17 Jun 2026). FY3/27 dividend raised to 20 yen/share; interim ordinary dividend FY3/26 increased 14→18 yen/share. Plan focuses on landfill waste intake expansion, organic growth, and shareholder dialogue to lift PBR; interim ROE decline expected from planned capex for new waste-processing facilities.
summary_jp: ROE推定WACC 7～9%超過継続が目標。FY3/26 ROE 17.3%、PBR 2.95倍（6月17日時点3.02倍）。FY3/27期末配当20円、FY3/26期末配当14→18円に増配。最終処分場受託量拡大、有機成長、株主対話によるPBR向上を計画。新規廃棄物処理施設投資から中期的ROE低下予想。
tag_en: COC Update – ROE >7-9% WACC target, maintain 15%+ level, PBR 2.95x as of FY3/26 close
tag_jp: 資本コスト対応 – ROE 7～9% WACC超過継続、15%+水準維持、PBR 2.95倍（3月期末時点）
